question: Should OpenClaw continue the Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap as staged bundled dashboard work, and which subitems should instead move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The issue spans bundled UI, plugin SDK, browser sandboxing, persistent state, command/data binding, visibility, install, and distribution boundaries that automation cannot safely choose for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review the linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before each stage lands.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing generic plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, galleries, and app bundles to prove themselves as external plugin or ClawHub packages first.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Leave the implementation stack unmerged and close or defer roadmap items if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in this product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review the linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before each stage lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the product/security boundary this roadmap builds on.
